policy: Verified facts are separated from experiments, informed inference, and unresolved claims.

claims: Project skills live under .bob/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md.
SKILL.md requires name and description frontmatter; skills without descriptions are ignored.
Supporting references/scripts can be colocated and main instructions should remain focused.
sources.implementation_implication: Created 36 curated Bob skills with activation-quality frontmatter and bounded supporting contracts; legacy catalog skills are non-activating.
sources.license_boundary: Documentation used to implement configuration; no vendor content copied into generated creative works.
sources.title: Skills
sources.uncertainty: The Skills page still contains an older statement that skills are only available in Advanced mode while the current changelog says default modes were simplified; package does not rely on that statement.

claims: Project personas live under .bob/agents/.
Personas shape spawned subagents rather than the main conversation.
name and description are required; tools can impose least-privilege ceilings.
sources.implementation_implication: Separated main task modes from 26 durable subagent personas; reviewers default to read-only tools.
sources.title: Agent personas
sources.uncertainty: Actual subagent execution is performed by IBM Bob, not by the repository's Python workflow engine.

claims: Project modes are defined in .bob/custom_modes.yaml.
Modes can restrict read/edit/execute/MCP/skill/workflow/todo/subtask/subagent/mode groups.
Modes can restrict allowed subagents.
sources.implementation_implication: Created eight whole-task production modes; independent QC receives no edit or execute group.
sources.title: Custom modes
sources.uncertainty: Repository workflows are intentionally not represented as an invented Bob custom-workflow package format.

claims: Workspace hooks are configured in .bob/settings.json.
Hooks run shell commands at lifecycle points and execute with user permissions.
sources.implementation_implication: Added narrow SessionStart and PreToolUse guard hooks only; no provider credentials or network actions are embedded.
sources.title: Lifecycle hooks
sources.uncertainty: Hook enforcement behavior depends on the installed Bob release; validator checks structure but cannot launch Bob in this environment.

claims: Project MCP configuration can live in .bob/mcp.json.
Servers can use local STDIO or network transports and support tool-level controls.
sources.implementation_implication: Added a local project MCP example that exposes bounded dry-run/read operations and contains no committed secrets.
sources.title: Using MCP in Bob
sources.uncertainty: The optional Python mcp package is not required for core CLI tests and may need installation in a Bob workspace.

claims: Current Bob includes subagents, lifecycle hooks, workspace trust, nested workflows and command security improvements.
Default modes were simplified to Plan, Agent and Ask with older Advanced/Orchestrator capability folded into defaults.
sources.implementation_implication: Avoided assuming legacy Advanced/Orchestrator semantics; package uses project modes and repository-owned runtime workflows.
sources.title: Changelog
sources.uncertainty: Changelog page intermixes multiple releases; exact installed Bob build remains an environment check.

claims: OTIO is an API and interchange format for editorial cut information and provides adapters/plugins for editorial interchange.
sources.implementation_implication: Selected OTIO as the intended editorial interchange extension point; v0.2 does not claim an OTIO adapter until contract tests exist.
sources.title: OpenTimelineIO documentation
sources.uncertainty: Not implemented in v0.2; remains P2 integration work.

claims: C2PA defines technical standards for content provenance/authenticity using Content Credentials.
Content Credentials bind provenance assertions to assets and include security guidance.
sources.implementation_implication: v0.2 uses deterministic hashes and reproduction manifests now, with an explicit C2PA export/signing extension point rather than falsely claiming C2PA compliance.
sources.license_boundary: Specification is CC BY 4.0 per specification site.
sources.organization: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity
sources.title: C2PA Specifications 2.4
sources.uncertainty: No signing/validation implementation ships in v0.2.

claims: OpenColorIO is a color-management solution geared toward motion-picture production, VFX and animation.
sources.implementation_implication: Color metadata is represented as an extension boundary; actual OCIO/ACES transforms are deferred until media fixtures and deterministic technical QC are added.
sources.title: OpenColorIO
sources.uncertainty: No OCIO transform is executed in v0.2.

claims: The Copyright Office's AI report separately addresses digital replicas and copyrightability of generative-AI outputs.
sources.implementation_implication: Rights and consent are separate typed records; the software never declares legal clearance and escalates human/legal decisions.
sources.title: Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
sources.uncertainty: Project-specific copyrightability and rights scope require counsel; software only records evidence and blockers.

claims: The 2026 MBA preserves 2023 AI protections and adds notice requirements if companies license writers' work for commercial generative-AI training.
sources.implementation_implication: Rights records include AI-processing/training distinctions and provenance; labor obligations remain human/legal review items.
sources.license_boundary: Labor/compliance research only; applicability depends on signatory status and project facts.
sources.title: Summary of the 2026 WGA MBA
sources.uncertainty: The package does not determine whether a production is covered by the MBA.

claims: The 2026 agreement builds on digital-replica protections and further restricts synthetic uses.
sources.implementation_implication: ConsentRecord explicitly separates voice clone, likeness and digital-replica scope and requires evidence/intended use before approval.
sources.license_boundary: Labor/compliance research only; applicability depends on agreement/project facts.
sources.title: 2026 TV/Theatrical AI protections
sources.uncertainty: The package does not interpret a collective bargaining agreement for a specific production.

claims: Runway's API catalog changes rapidly and includes multiple current video/image/audio models with different durations, references, resolution and billing rules.
sources.implementation_implication: Provider capabilities are dated manifests and adapter-owned; model IDs are never embedded in story/shot domain logic.
sources.license_boundary: Capability research only; no API use performed.
sources.title: API Changelog & Updates
sources.uncertainty: Privacy, retention, regional terms and per-account limits must be checked at authorization time; no Runway adapter is enabled in v0.2.

claims: Google documents Gemini Omni Flash as its default video-generation recommendation and Veo 3.1 for capabilities including native audio, scene extension and frame-specific control.
sources.implementation_implication: Capability-based routing must query dated features rather than assume a single best model.
sources.license_boundary: Capability research only; no API use performed.
sources.title: Video generation in the Gemini API
sources.uncertainty: No Google adapter is enabled in v0.2; availability and model identifiers must be reverified before live use.

claims: Higgsfield exposes image, video and audio operations through an OAuth-connected MCP endpoint and generation consumes provider credits.
sources.implementation_implication: Retained Higgsfield only as a replaceable boundary and did not auto-connect or execute paid MCP calls; project MCP server is local and provider-neutral.
sources.license_boundary: Capability research only. Third-party production prompts/assets are not copied or embedded.
sources.title: How to connect Higgsfield to Claude via MCP
sources.uncertainty: Higgsfield account terms, privacy, retention and per-model policy must be verified before authorized integration.
